how.title: How it works
how.subtitle: Karoora keessan irraa kaasee hanga yeroo dinqisiisaatti tarkaanfiiwwan salphaa sadii.
how.step1Body: Call or WhatsApp us with who you want to surprise, the occasion, and when. Our team guides you through the rest.
how.step2Body: We source the cake, flowers, decorations, venue setup and more — you don't lift a finger. We confirm when it's all ready.
how.step3Body: Your person walks into a moment they never saw coming. We handle the setup. You take all the credit.
how.secrecyFootnote: %100 Iccitii: Hanga yeroo gubbaatti mul'atutti waan tokkoyyuu hin shakkan.

faq.title: Odoo Surprise Hin Karoorsin Dura Wanta Beekuu Qabdan
faq.subtitle: Iccitii eeguu, iddoowwan geessituu, filannoowwan addaa fi kaffaltii irratti deebiiwwan keenya.
faq.q1: Surprise %100 iccitii akka ta'u akkamitti wabii taatu?
faq.a1: Iccitii eeguun dhimma keenya isa jalqabaati. Namoota biroo wajjin yeroo mari'annu waa'ee surprise tasuma hin kaafnu, konkolaataan keenya asxaa hin qabu, gareen keenyas hanga sa'aatii dhumaatti qindoomina iccitii cimaan hojjeta.
faq.a2: Dukam, Bishooftuu fi Naannoo Shawaa Bahaa hunda keessatti ni dhiheessina. Akkasumas fedhii addaatiin Finfinnee fi naannoo isheetti ni qindeessina.
faq.q3: Mi'aawa keekii, abaaboo ykn faaya jijjiiruu nan danda'aa?
faq.a3: Eeyyee, guutummaatti! Fedhii fi jaalala keessan irratti hundaa'uun gosa keekii, bifa abaaboo, baalloonii fi waraqaa ergaa harkaan barreeffamu hunda ni qindeessina.
faq.q4: Yeroo hangam dura qabsiisuu qaba, kaffaltiin duraa hoo meeqa?
faq.a4: Qophii idileetiif sa'aatii 24-48 dura akka nu qunnamtan gorsina. Kaffaltiin duraa %25 guyyaa keessan mirkaneessa.
